doc.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Willy Mitchell's big band at Melrose
summary: Lloyd hears Willy Mitchell's Dizzy-style big band at Melrose, where the players already knew Bird.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: And he and my father were college roommates, you understand.
So I think they went to Fisk. So what I’m saying is that... I heard Willy Mitchell at Melrose, he had a big band. They was playing, like Dizzy’s big band.
Fats, Sonny, alto, played, crossed his legs. Uh oh, Fats, Sonny just crossed his legs. You know!
Oh man, and they had heard Bird, they knew what that was.
